meta.title: Extending after an award proposal exists is refused with 801

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event the QA vendor bid on, closed, and awarded to that vendor (award submitted for approval).
steps: The buyer sends the request that updates the round, exactly as the matching library case writes it.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “You cannot edit the time as proposals are already submitted.”, and never with a server error.

plan.title: Extending after an award proposal exists is refused with 801

expected.message: You cannot edit the time as proposals are already submitted.
